name: Aicha Kandicha
body:
Aicha Kandicha CR 7

This strange, beautiful woman wears a long skirt, and the sound of clacking accompanies her otherwise graceful steps.

XP 3,200
NE Medium outsider (evil, extraplanar, shapechanger)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13; Aura seductive presence (10 feet)

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 16, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +4 natural, +4 profane)
hp 85 (9d10+36)
Fort +9, Ref +10, Will +7
Defensive Abilities ferocity; DR 10/good; Immune acid, poison; Resist cold 10, electricity 10, fire 10; SR 18

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +13 (1d8+3 plus charming claw)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 9th, concentration +13)

At will—charm person (DC 15), darkness, detect evil, detect good, detect thoughts (DC 16), tongues
3/day—deep slumber (DC 17), fear (DC 18), suggestion (DC 17)
1/day—dimension door, dominate person (DC 19)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 19, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 19
Base Atk +9; CMB +12; CMD 28
Feats Alertness, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Acrobatics +11, Bluff +16, Diplomacy +16, Knowledge (local) +13, Perception +15, Sense Motive +15, Stealth +14
Languages Abyssal, Common; telepathy 100 ft.
SQ bovid demonica, change shape (Large bovine; beast shape II), cult of personality, telepathic bond

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bovid Demonica (Su)

As a move action, an aicha kandicha can transform into her true form, a cow-human hybrid with glowing golden eyes. In this form, she gains a gore attack with an attack roll of +13, dealing 1d8+4 points of piercing damage, and can use this gore with the powerful charge special attack (2d8+8). Her gore attack is considered magical and evil for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Charming Claw (Su)

If an aicha kandicha desires to, she can charm a humanoid she has struck with her claw. If the target fails at a DC 18 Will save, it is charmed for 1 day. If the target suffers any harm from the aicha kandicha or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the saving throw. If the target succeeds at its saving throw, the target is immune to the aicha kandicha’s charming claw for 24 hours. She can only have one creature charmed like this at a time. The effect ends for the previous creature when she charms another. This is a mind-affecting charm effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Cult of Personality (Su)

An aicha kandicha adds her Charisma bonus as a profane bonus to her Armor Class and damage with her natural attacks.

Seductive Presence (Su)

Any creature within 10 feet of an aicha kandicha that could be sexually attracted to her takes a -2 penalty on saving throws against mind-affecting effects she uses and she gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks against them.

Telepathic Bond (Su)

An aicha kandicha can communicate telepathically with a creature she has charmed at any distance, even across planar boundaries.

An aicha kandicha is a mysterious woman who lurks by night. She covers her legs with broad skirts because she has hooves like a cow rather than human feet. She otherwise looks beautiful and flirts with men and seduces them but then turns into a demon-cow and devours them claiming their souls for one of the lords of the lower planes.
